title: All 97 Outfits - Expedition 33 Costume Guide & Locations
description: Complete outfit guide for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. All 97 unlockable costumes, locations, unlock methods including DLC outfits and swimsuits.

sections.title: Outfits Overview
sections.content:
Maelle - outfit customization

Expedition 33 has 97 unlockable outfits across all characters. Outfits are purely cosmetic and obtained through side quests, merchants, exploration, relationship levels, and DLC content.

Unlock Methods

MethodExamplesCount
Side QuestsNPC quest rewards~30
MerchantsPurchased from vendors~20
ExplorationFound in chests/hidden areas~25
RelationshipsMax relationship rewards (e.g., Swimsuits at Level 6)~10
Story/EndingsDefeating Maelle ending, talking to NPCs~5
DLCChic, Osquio, Visage, Baguette outfits~7

sections.title: DLC Outfits (Patch 1.5+)
sections.content:
New DLC Outfits

  • Chic Outfit — Elegant formal wear for characters
  • Monoco Baguette Outfit — Unique Monoco-specific costume
  • Esquire Outfit — Dapper gentleman style
  • Osquio Outfit — Multiple locations across the world
  • Visage Outfit — Mysterious masked appearance

DLC outfits are found at specific new locations added in patches. Check merchant inventories and new areas after updating.

sections.title: Outfits by Character
sections.content:
Gustave

  • Default, Expedition formal, Arena Champion, Chic, + exploration finds

Lune

  • Default, Ceremonial, Swimsuit I (Relationship Lv6), + quest rewards

Maelle

  • Default, Arena outfit (from Gestral Arena — earn Medalum weapon here too), + combat rewards
  • Special: Maelle Ending outfit (defeat Clea → talk to Young Boy in Central Plaza)

Sciel

  • Default, Civilian (choose to fight as Maelle at end), Swimsuit I (Relationship Lv6)

Verso

  • Default + multiple unlockable styles through exploration and quests

Monoco

  • Default, Baguette (DLC), + Gestral-themed outfits

sections.title: Swimsuit Outfits
sections.content:
Swimsuits are unlocked by reaching Relationship Level 6 with specific characters:

  • Lune Swimsuit I — Reach Relationship Level 6 with Lune
  • Sciel Swimsuit I — Reach Relationship Level 6 with Sciel
  • Other characters have similar swimsuit unlocks at high relationship levels

See our Camp Guide for tips on building relationships quickly.

sections.title: Tips for Collecting All Outfits
sections.content:
• Talk to every merchant — Many outfits are simply purchased from vendors
  • Complete all side quests — A large portion of outfits come from quest rewards
  • Max relationships — Level 6 unlocks swimsuits, earlier levels give other outfits
  • Explore off the beaten path — Hidden chests in secret areas contain exclusive outfits
  • Check after story milestones — New outfits become available at vendors after major events
  • DLC areas — Update to latest patch and explore new locations for Chic/Osquio/Visage sets
  • Multiple playthroughs — Some outfits require specific Chosen Path routes or endings
